tasks.task: Confirm and connect the vault folder
Hand-write 3–5 sample notes across CABAL Mobile, RED, Pride
Build one Bases view over the sample notes
Confirm the view answers real lookup questions; adjust schema if not
Decide what counts as "key information" for an image (D-006)
Set up the Inbox convention (folder or note)
Draft and finalize the rule table for known Drive/Canva locations
Test Canva connector text extraction on one real CABAL RED design (D-008)
Run the pipeline manually end-to-end on one source per format
Review and correct AI-inferred categorizations from the trial run
Turn the pipeline into a repeatable checklist or prompt
Build the rule table as an editable config file
Set up a Cowork scheduled task fired on demand (optional)
Evaluate whether volume justifies a standalone script
Build standalone script calling Google/Canva/Claude APIs directly (only if triggered)

tests.validates: Every field in the note schema captures what's actually needed
The three vault views return the right notes when filtered/grouped
One real source each for Google Doc, Sheet, Canva, CSV, image, text runs through the pipeline without manual fixes
Rule-matched and AI-fallback categorizations are correct on a sample of 10 sources
Re-submitting the same source updates the existing note instead of duplicating it

integrations.name: Google Drive
integrations.role: Source — Docs and Sheets are read directly for extraction

integrations.name: Canva
integrations.role: Source — slide decks and designs, text extraction depth still unverified (D-008)

integrations.name: Obsidian
integrations.role: Destination — the vault N.O.V.A. writes structured notes into, queried via Bases/Dataview

integrations.name: Claude / Cowork
integrations.role: The extraction, summarization, and categorization engine that runs the pipeline

integrations.name: n8n
integrations.role: Proposed for automating the Inbox trigger — exact workflow not yet defined (D-010, open)
